t: You are in the Hungerford Bridge arches on the South Bank, at what is now Bar Topolski. It used to be a gallery showing a huge artwork by Feliks Topolski, a Polish expressionist painter and draughtsman who worked mainly in Britain. In 2013, with few visitors and rising rents, the gallery became a bar. Some of his work still hangs here, and the rest was moved to a private studio.
